name: Citizen of Kalabuto
text:
**Citizen of Kalabuto** (regional trait; Kalabuto)

You live and work in Kalabuto. You gain a +1 trait bonus on all Knowledge (local) and Knowledge (history) checks regarding Kalabuto.
